{{Quote|She broke the Mandalorian blockade at the Hydian Way. You know, the one that strangled Coruscant and dashed a full-scale Jedi assault.|[[Gault Rennow]], about [[Hylo Visz]]|<ref name="TOR:EaO">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Exes and Ohs}}</ref>}}
In [[3661 BBY]],<ref name="Startdate" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], near [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The conflict was the result of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], and was initiated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in an attempt to open the Hydian Way for the shipping of [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] goods. The attempt proved to be unsuccessful, and the Jedi strike force was wiped out. The Mandalorians maintained their blockade<ref name="TJoMGD" /> until [[3660 BBY]],<ref name="Enddate">"[[Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken]]" and [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] indicate that the Blockade of the Hydian Way is broken seven years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. As seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty of Coruscant is proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]] led a [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|group of smugglers]] into battle against the warrior clans.<ref name="TJoMGD" />
